What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
worked_solution:
The vertex of a left-opening parabola is the right-most point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13955030/assets/5410d736f7bae2f5c968d52083745b91279913045405ad75d154cf6b05bba4bd.png)

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(2,0).$
